text:
mike: Deploy-bot flagged canary for payments-service 1.13.0 -> 1.14.0 failed health checks, pods OOM/evicted.

deploy-bot: [deployment-payments] canary rollout failed: 3/5 pods Ready, RestartCount increased, event: "OOMKilled" and "Evicted". Logs: "CrashLoopBackOff -> OOMKilled". Canary attached values: cpu.requests: 200m -> 500m. Helm release: payments-frontend. Command: `helm upgrade --install payments ./charts/payments --values values/canary-1.14.0.yaml --set image.tag=1.14.0 --wait --timeout 5m`

sara: re: values — did someone push a default values bump? I only see image tag change in CI.

jamie: checked git: values/canary-1.14.0.yaml has cpu.requests: 500m, memory: 1Gi. Previous chart default was 200m/512Mi. PR #8421 included a chart-level values bump for v1.14.0 to increase perf for heavy requests.

priya: that CPU bump explains eviction on small node pools. Canary nodes are burstable t3-small equivalents.

mike: options: rollback to 1.13.0, pin chart to previous values, or rollforward with node pool scale/bigger instance type. Thoughts?

release-manager: we have a change window open for the next 45m. If we rollback, do we do a helm rollback or force image pin with `helm upgrade --set image.tag=1.13.0`?

jamie: safest is rollback the release to the previous revision: `helm rollback payments 42 --wait --timeout 5m` (where 42 is last successful revision). That reverts chart+values. Quick and minimal.

sara: if we rollback, we should also revert the PR that bumped defaults so it doesn't auto-apply on next deploy.

priya: alternative: hotfix values override for canary only: `helm upgrade payments ./charts/payments --set cpu.requests=200m --reuse-values --wait` but that leaves chart version at 1.14.0; may hide regression.

mike: agree rollback + revert PR. Release-manager, can you approve rollback now? I'll monitor pods.

release-manager: approved. kicking off rollback.

deploy-bot: Action: starting helm rollback payments -> revision 42

deploy-bot: `helm rollback payments 42` started by mike at 2026-03-20T14:05:12Z

deploy-bot: Rollback completed: release payments deployed as revision 43. Post-check: 5/5 pods Ready. Canary status: healthy :white_check_mark:

mike: monitoring logs for 5m.

jamie: created a follow-up issue to add node selectors/limits and to document values impacts on small node pools. cc @platform

sara: opened PR to revert chart defaults (link) and added test to CI to run small-node smoke.

priya: noted. Also adding a preflight check to the deploy-bot to compare cpu.requests delta >2x and warn.

mike: thanks all. Closing thread once PR merges. :thumbsup:
